entries.summary: Phase 1 completed: Backend WebSocket server (server.py) with asyncio+websockets, Tetris game logic (game.py) with 7-piece Board class, scoring, line clearing, garbage attack mechanics, room management, heartbeat, game loops, and rematch. All 3 tasks passed syntax check, SAST scan, and functional tests.
top_rejection_reasons: broadcast sync def called with await (CRITICAL)
lessons_learned: broadcast() must be async def when called with await
Per-player gravity timestamps prevent speed mismatch bugs
Hold swap failure must restore board state atomically
check_game_over winner logic must directly target loser/winner without ternary confusion
Server disconnect opponent notification must happen before player removal
